## About
I'm Ken Ellison, owner and operator of Ellison's Machine Shop. We're a full service machine shop specializing in custom engine design and building, for auto, truck and industrial work, imports or domestic, gas or diesel.
I'm probably best known for what the shop has done at the drag strip, but my first love is muscle car engines. Restoring one is more than engine building. It's a way of preserving automotive history. A lot of our work also comes from local new car dealerships on late model engines still under the manufacturer's warranty.
You'll find us on Ritchie Hwy in Glen Burnie, sharing the Fisher Auto Parts building. Customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 49 Google reviews, and we ask you to please tell your friends.

## Services
- Custom Engine Design: Ken's specialty: custom engine design and building.
- Cylinder head resurfacing
- Competition style valve jobs
- Crankshaft polishing and grinding
- Deck plate power stroke honing
- OEM re-manufactured connecting rods: Available as singles or in sets, reasonably priced.
- Press work: One reviewer brought in parts that were seized together and wouldn't come apart without a press.
- Drums and rotors turned

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on diesels and imports?
A: Yes. We work on imports or domestic, gas or diesel.

Q: Do you turn flywheels?
A: Not right now. We are not turning flywheels at this time.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 7218 Ritchie Hwy. in Glen Burnie, sharing the Fisher Auto Parts building.

Q: When are you open?
A: Weekdays, Monday through Friday. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

## What customers say
- "I would recommend Ellison Machine Shop to anyone needed professional, respectful, and timely service. It shocks me that there are any reviews that are anything less than 5 stars. I needed a new wheel bearing, hub, and upper ball joint pressed into a steering knuckle on my 01 Tacoma. My CV axle had failed due to improper alignment, and my wheel completely sheared off the studs as I was driving. After removing the knuckle, I called Ken at EMS who was nothing but helpful and understanding of my situation as a student at the United States Naval Academy. I decided to bring my own new parts to Ken to be pressed in, and he detected that one of them was the incorrect size supplied to me by a local Toyota dealership. He was able to source the correct part himself that same day, and had my fully repaired knuckle ready for me to pick up the next morning. I have called many other shops for small jobs like this, as I do not have access to a hydraulic press or many advanced kits for press work like this. Every time they tell me they are too busy, or would not make enough money. I always prefer to do my own work, but when I know I am outside of my own knowledge and limit, I would always trust EMS to take care of my needs. 2 months later and still no issues with my daily driver. A huge thank you to Ken and his team over in Maryland. Very relatable guy, and lots of experience in his craft, nothing but positive things to say." (Anthony Cervini, 5/5)

Little did they know that they were doing me a huge favor without knowing. This is a rush job that I'm doing for my parents who need their vehicle back for their daily travels.
